title: Parisi formula for Ising and Spherical Perceptrons
summary: We prove a Parisi formula for Ising and spherical perceptrons with Gaussian disorder and i.i.d. random potentials having a common Lipschitz bound and integrable values at zero. We assume $M/N\to\alpha\in(0,\infty)$, where $M$ is the number of Gaussian vectors and $N$ is the number of spins. The proof combines cavity in $M$ and $N$ with the Aizenman–Sims–Starr scheme for the lower bound and Guerra’s interpolation for the upper bound.
